Should the outflow be a transfer, other financing use, or spending?

notes: Cash-basis village; one governmental fund (General, with Street, Library Accounts, Cemetery and Keno sub-accounts shown on the combining schedule p8). The governmental fund statement rolls forward fund balance (370,563 -> 417,661), recorded as beginning/ending_fund_balance; cash fields left null (no beginning cash printed). Business-type (Water, Sewer, Ambulance) from the proprietary statement Total column p6; measure net position (cash basis); no single printed receipts total (operating 334,991 + interest 3,723); disbursements total 330,749 printed on the Statement of Activities p2. Detail: combining schedule p8 recorded per sub-fund column; the General Fund budget-and-actual schedule p7 (same fund, total only) omitted to avoid double counting. Business-type funds have no supplementary schedule, so no business-type detail. Governmental capital outlay 22,468 is public safety 884 + culture and recreation 21,584 per the Statement of Activities, kept as one printed line. Read pages 1-8 of 8
